SELECT z.Borough, COUNT(*) AS touches
FROM lake.trips t
JOIN ops.zones z ON z.LocationID = t.PULocationID
GROUP BY z.Borough
UNION ALL
SELECT z.Borough, COUNT(*) AS touches
FROM lake.trips t
JOIN ops.zones z ON z.LocationID = t.DOLocationID
GROUP BY z.Borough
ORDER BY Borough

SELECT Borough, SUM(cnt) AS touches
FROM (
    SELECT z.Borough, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM lake.trips t
    JOIN ops.zones z ON z.LocationID = t.PULocationID
    GROUP BY z.Borough
    UNION ALL
    SELECT z.Borough, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM lake.trips t
    JOIN ops.zones z ON z.LocationID = t.DOLocationID
    GROUP BY z.Borough
)
GROUP BY Borough
ORDER BY Borough

SELECT z.Borough, SUM(cnt) AS touches
FROM (
    SELECT PULocationID AS LocationID, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM lake.trips GROUP BY PULocationID
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DOLocationID AS LocationID, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM lake.trips GROUP BY DOLocationID
) tc
JOIN ops.zones z ON z.LocationID = tc.LocationID
GROUP BY z.Borough
ORDER BY z.Borough

SELECT z.LocationID, z.Borough, z.Zone, COALESCE(t.cnt, 0) AS cash_trips
FROM ops.zones z
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT PULocationID, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM lake.trips
    WHERE payment_type = 2
    GROUP BY PULocationID
) t ON t.PULocationID = z.LocationID
ORDER BY z.LocationID

SELECT z.LocationID, z.Borough, z.Zone, COALESCE(t.cnt, 0) AS cash_trips
FROM ops.zones z
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT PULocationID, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM lake.trips
    WHERE payment_type = 2
    GROUP BY PULocationID
) t ON t.PULocationID = z.LocationID
ORDER BY z.LocationID

SELECT z.LocationID, z.Borough, z.Zone, COALESCE(t.cnt, 0) AS cash_trips
FROM ops.zones z
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT PULocationID, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM lake.trips
    WHERE payment_type = 2
    GROUP BY PULocationID
) t ON t.PULocationID = z.LocationID
ORDER BY z.LocationID
SELECT DISTINCT PULocationID, payment_type, passenger_count FROM lake.trips WHERE trip_distance > 30 OR fare_amount > 100

SELECT PULocationID, payment_type, passenger_count
FROM lake.trips
WHERE trip_distance > 30 OR fare_amount > 100

SELECT PULocationID, payment_type, passenger_count
FROM lake.trips
WHERE trip_distance > 30 OR fare_amount > 100

SELECT z.LocationID, z.Zone
FROM ops.zones z
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM lake.trips t
    WHERE t.PULocationID = z.LocationID
      AND t.RatecodeID = z.LocationID
)
ORDER BY z.LocationID

SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) AS trips
FROM lake.trips
GROUP BY payment_type
ORDER BY payment_type
